scope: All 32 mapped Grands-Échezeaux parcels inventoried; all nine recorded right holders revisited at Tier 2. No verified current farmer; not an exhaustive search of every archive.

historicalEvents.summary: The application covers 4.3080 ha in Flagey-Échezeaux, Boncourt-le-Bois, Vosne-Romanée and Vougeot, including Grands-Échezeaux D615 and D616. The region found the enlargement excessive and suspended the instruction, during which anyone may apply for the same land. As of the order, the applicant was not authorised to farm these parcels.
